item.name: 🔗 Get List of Accounts

request.description:
Retrieve the list of accounts for the authenticated user.

```
GET /v1/accounts?hostUserId={{retail_user_host_user_id}}
```

Retrieve the list of accounts for the authenticated user.

```

item.name: 🔗 Get A Single Account

```
GET /v1/accounts/{{account_id}}?hostUserId={{retail_user_host_user_id}}
```

item.description:
## 🔄 Retail User – Get A Single Account Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token V2 | Obtain an access token (OAuth V2) using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Account ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the account ID if it is not already known. |
| 3 | Get A Single Account | Retrieve detailed information for the specified account using its account ID. |

request.description:
Retrieve the retail institution user and identify `retail_customer_id` and `retail_subuser_auth_id`.

Saves `retail_customer_id`, `retail_subuser_auth_id` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/institution-users/{{retail_user_host_user_id}}?userIdType=HOST_USER_ID&$expand=subUsers
```

item.description:
## 🔄 **Retail User – Retrieve Retail Customer ID and Sub-User(s) Auth ID Flow** | **Step** | Request Name | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | | 1a | \[Option 1\] Generate Access Token V2 - Client Credentials | Obtain an access token (OAuth V2) using client credentials to authorize API requests. | | 1b | \[Option 2\] Generate Access Token V2 - Password | Obtain an access token (OAuth V2) using user credentials to authorize API requests. | | 2 | Search for Retail Customer ID and Sub-Users Auth ID | Use this step to retrieve the Retail Customer ID and Sub-User(s) Auth ID(s) if they are not already known.
• The Retail Customer ID is located in the institutionCustomers array as the institutionCustomerId.
• The Sub-User Auth ID(s) are found in the subUsers array, identified by the userId field. |

item.name: 1a. [Option 1] Generate Access Token V1 - Client Credentials
2a. [Option 1] Get List of Accounts (Legacy) - Primary Retail User

request.description:
Retrieve the primary retail user's accounts using the legacy banking-services API.

```
GET /bankingservices/v2/fis/{{institution_id}}/fiCustomers/{{retail_customer_id}}/accounts?getCrossAccts=true&getExportAcctNum=true
```

Retrieve a retail sub-user's accounts using the legacy banking-services API.

Sends `intuit_IFS_userType=ENTITLED` and `intuit_authid={{retail_subuser_auth_id}}`.

```
GET /bankingservices/v2/fis/{{institution_id}}/fiCustomers/{{retail_customer_id}}/accounts?getCrossAccts=true&getExportAcctNum=true
```

item.description:
## 🔄 Retail User – Get List of Accounts (Legacy) Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1a | \[Option 1\] Generate Access Token V1 - Client Credentials | Obtain an access token (OAuth V1) using client credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 1b | \[Option 2\] Generate Access Token V1 - Password | Obtain an access token (OAuth V1) using user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2a | \[Option 1\] Get List of Accounts (Legacy) - Primary Retail User | Retrieve the list of accounts associated with the primary retail user. |
| 2b | \[Option 2\] Get List of Accounts (Legacy) - SubUser | Retrieve the list of accounts associated with the entitled retail user (sub-user). |

item.name: 🔗 Get List of Accounts

request.description:
Retrieve the business customer record and identify `institution_customer_id` for subsequent requests.

Saves `skip_groups`, `institution_customer_id` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/customers/{{business_user_login_id}}?userIdType=LOGIN_ID
```

item.name: 3a. [Option 1] Get List of Accounts By Group

request.description:
Retrieve accounts grouped by customer for the business user.

```
GET /v1/accounts?loginId={{business_user_login_id}}&$apply=groupBy(customer)&$topGroups=1&$skipGroups={{skip_groups}}
```

item.name: 3b. [Option 2] Get List of Accounts By InstitutionCustomerId

request.description:
Retrieve the list of accounts for a specific business location.

```
GET /v1/accounts?loginId={{business_user_login_id}}&institutionCustomerId={{institution_customer_id}}
```

Retrieve the business customer record and identify `institution_customer_id` for subsequent requests.

Saves `skip_groups`, `institution_customer_id` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/customers/{{business_user_login_id}}?userIdType=LOGIN_ID
```

item.name: 3a. [Option 1] Get List of Accounts By Group

request.description:
Retrieve accounts grouped by customer for the business user.

```
GET /v1/accounts?$apply=groupBy(customer)&$topGroups=1&$skipGroups={{skip_groups}}
```

item.name: 3b. [Option 2] Get List of Accounts By InstitutionCustomerId

request.description:

```

item.description:
## 🔄 Business User – Get List of Accounts Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token V2 | Obtain an access token (OAuth V2) using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Business Entity | (Optional) Use this step to locate the institution customer ID if it’s not already available. Retrieve business user details and match the memberNumber (TIN/EIN) to identify the corresponding institutionCustomerId or skipGroups. |
| 3a | \[Option 1\] Get List of Accounts By Group | Retrieve the list of accounts associated with the business entity by referencing the index of the institutionCustomers list. |
| 3b | \[Option 1\] Get List of Accounts By InstitutionCustomerId | Retrieve the list of accounts associated with the business entity using the institutionCustomerId. |

item.description:
## 🔄 **Business User – Retrieve Business Location Flow**

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token V2 | Obtain an access token (OAuth V2) using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Business Entity | Use this step to determine the institution customer ID if it is not already known. Retrieve the business user details and match the member number (TIN/EIN) to identify the corresponding institutionCustomerId. For SECONDARY_ADMIN or BUSINESS_USER roles, retrieve the loginId and use it as the value for intuit_authid. |

item.name: 2a. [Option 1] Get List of Accounts - Primary Admin

request.description:
Retrieve accounts for a business primary admin using the legacy banking-services API.

Sends `intuit_IFS_userType=PRIMARY_ADMIN`.

```
GET /bankingservices/v2/fis/{{institution_id}}/fiCustomers/{{institution_customer_id}}/accounts?getExportAcctNum=true&validateLocationStatus=true
```

item.name: 2b. [Option 2] Get List of Accounts - Secondary Admin

request.description:
Retrieve accounts for a business secondary admin using the legacy banking-services API.

Sends `intuit_IFS_userType=SECONDARY_ADMIN` and `intuit_authid={{business_user_auth_id}}`.

```
GET /bankingservices/v2/fis/{{institution_id}}/fiCustomers/{{institution_customer_id}}/accounts?getExportAcctNum=true&validateLocationStatus=true
```

item.name: 2c. [Option 3] Get List of Accounts - Business User

request.description:
Retrieve accounts for a business user using the legacy banking-services API.

Sends `intuit_IFS_userType=BUSINESS_USER` and `intuit_authid={{business_user_auth_id}}`.

```
GET /bankingservices/v2/fis/{{institution_id}}/fiCustomers/{{institution_customer_id}}/accounts?getExportAcctNum=true&validateLocationStatus=true
```

item.description:
## 🔄 Business User – Get List of Accounts (Legacy) Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token V1 | Obtain an access token (OAuth V1) using client credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2a | \[Option 1\] Get List of Accounts - Primary Admin | Retrieve the list of accounts associated with the business's primary administrator. |
| 2b | \[Option 2\] Get List of Accounts - Secondary Admin | Retrieve the list of accounts associated with the business's secondary administrator. |
| 2c | \[Option 3\] Get List of Accounts - Business User | Retrieve the list of accounts associated with a business user. |
